title: A sort that reorders the caller's array
prompt: ranking.ts sorts the array it was given, so the caller's own order is destroyed and the bug appears somewhere else entirely. Make the parameter readonly and return a new array, without changing what the function returns.
check: codeonly ranking.ts | grep -qE '\breadonly\b' && ! codeonly ranking.ts | grep -qE '(rows|input|items)\.(sort|reverse|push|splice)\(' && grep -q 'export function ranked' ranking.ts
